['Biontech SE '].company_description: BioNTech SE is a German biotechnology company that develops and manufactures active immunotherapies for patient-specific approaches to the treatment of diseases. It focuses on developing pharmaceutical candidates based on messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) for individualized cancer immunotherapies, vaccines against infectious diseases, and protein replacement therapies for rare diseases. The company has also developed an mRNA-based human therapeutic for intravenous administration and has collaborated with Pfizer to develop the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, which has been authorized for use in preventing COVID-19 infections.

['Total Energies Holding Deutschland Gmb.company_description: Total Energies Holding Deutschland GmbH operates in trading and sea transport of crude oil and oil products, petroleum products distribution, and electricity generation from combined cycle gas plants and renewable energies. The company is also pursuing growth in the renewable energy sector and has a focus on climate change-related challenges, people's well-being, and care for the environment. Additionally, TotalEnergies has been awarded marine concessions by the German Federal Network Agency.
